requirements.text: Escalate the pending case CS-0001179 assigned to Installed Base Support group for investigation on customer request
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 1179 AND escalation = 1 AND escalation_reason = 'customer_request' AND state = 'in_progress'
assumptions: CS-0001179 is case_id 1179 in the seed: pending, assignment_group_id 10 (Installed Base Support), assigned to user 473, escalation 0
escalation_reason customer_request from 'on customer request', a value in the policy's list; the policy records escalation = true and the reason on the case
state in_progress implied by the request, not stated: 'for investigation' takes the case out of pending, and pending to in_progress is a valid transition; kept from the benchmark check
the caller (user 473) is an agent, but the policy has the assistant act with admin rights by default, so the escalation is allowed

requirements.text: Escalate the pending case CS-0001179 ... for investigation
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_sla WHERE case_sla_id = 2358 AND stage = 'in_progress'
assumptions: implied by the request, not stated: the policy pauses SLAs only while the case is pending, so the paused resolution SLA resumes when the case goes to in_progress
case_sla 2358 is case 1179's resolution SLA (definition 9), paused on the seed; its response SLA 2357 is already in_progress and is not tested

requirements.text: Apply knowledge article to help in resolving
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 1179 AND knowledge_id = 206 AND used_as = 'suggested'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (highest case_kb_id is 527); this is the only case_knowledge row the task creates
knowledge 206 (KB-0000206) is the only article for the case's product 137, Cisco Catalyst 9300 Variant 5, and is published
used_as suggested kept from the benchmark check: the request names no article, so it is found by knowledge search, which the policy links as suggested

requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 1179 AND knowledge_id <> 206
assumptions: boundary of the article: the other Cisco Catalyst 9300 articles (192, 224, 241, 257, 258 published; 240 retired) belong to other products, and a search on the product family would return them

notes:
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that no article other than 206 is linked to case 1179; one pass has it, the other does not; kept because the request names no article, so it is picked by description, and six near-match Catalyst 9300 articles on other products (one retired, which the policy forbids linking) are what a loose search would sweep in, the boundary of that selector, not a generic invariant.
The benchmark's 'Update sla ' check reads case_sla 2358's stage and tests that it contains in_progress; the requirement counts the same condition as stage = 'in_progress', which is equivalent over the stage values.
The policy asks for the escalation's justification to be logged in case notes, but the schema has no case-notes table or column, so nothing tests it.
used_as is the least settled cell: the request's word 'Apply' could be read as the enum value applied, and 'to help in resolving' as resolution; the benchmark's suggested is kept because the policy fixes used_as by how the article is found, and here it can only be found by search.
The acting user 473 is an active agent assigned to the case; the policy has the assistant act with admin rights by default, so the manager-only right to escalate does not block the request.
